item.title: Nevada Donor Network Announces Promotion of Elizabeth Shaller to Chief Operating Officer
item.description: Nevada Donor Network (NDN) announced today Elizabeth Shaller has been promoted to chief operating officer. Shaller has served as the vice president of organ operations since 2022 and will now take on additional responsibilities as chief operating officer. Shaller possesses vast expertise in organ donation and transplantation management. Her advocacy for the use of new technologies has positioned NDN at the forefront of the innovation field, marking significant advancements in organ preservation
